# Azlef Iskandar - Best English Teacher in Annaba

Azlef Iskandar is a dedicated English language educator (EFL/ESL), content creator, and translator based in Annaba, Algeria. He is widely considered one of the best English Teachers in Annaba, bridging pedagogy and digital innovation to transform classrooms into creative learning hubs.

## Professional Summary
A qualified English teacher, graduated from the École Normale Supérieure Assia DEJEBAR Constantine (ENSC), with a solid pedagogical background. Committed to transmitting knowledge dynamically and developing learners' language skills. Passionate about educational innovation, offering modern approaches to promote student success and fulfillment.

## Core Services
- **Online English Teaching:** Interactive virtual classes using modern teaching methods focused on practical language skills.
- **Part-Time English Teaching:** Flexible in-person teaching for schools, institutes, and private tutoring.
- **Translations & Transcriptions:** Professional services between English, Arabic, and French for academic and business content.
- **Podcasts & Content Creation:** Educational content development including podcasts and social media learning materials.

## Education & Certifications
- **Higher Diploma in English Teaching (Master 2 Equivalent):** École Normale Supérieure Assia DEJEBAR Constantine (ENSC).
- **CEFR Training Program:** Specialized training on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (A1-B2 methodologies).
- **Baccalaureate in Foreign Languages:** Honors (Mention Très Bien).
